user_query: I'm a business owner and I'm looking for a reliable email marketing service to promote my products. Can you provide me with information about the top email marketing services available? Additionally, I'm interested in calculating the carbon footprint of my company's transportation. Please estimate the carbon equivalent for the annual mileage of our delivery vehicles.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of top email marketing services available along with their features and pricing.
Retrieve reviews and user feedback on the top email marketing services identified in Subtask 1.
Calculate the carbon footprint based on the annual mileage of the company's delivery vehicles.
Provide an estimate of the carbon equivalent for the calculated carbon footprint.
